'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of South Korea]]
**[[South Korea]]’s [[Bank of Korea|central bank]] cuts its key [[interest rate]] by a quarter percentage point to 2.5%, marking its fourth cut since October, and sharply lowered its 2025 growth forecast to 0.8%, nearly halving the previous projection of 1.5% announced in February after a monetary policy meeting. [[Share (finance)|Share]] prices rise following the report, with the [[Kospi]] gaining 1.7%. [https://apnews.com/article/korea-economy-rate-tariffs-trump-d2cf5ea0db7ad02147f144ba50c7ee4b (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 South Korean Lockheed P-3 Orion crash]]
**Four people are killed when a [[South Korean Navy]] [[Lockheed P-3 Orion|Lockheed P3-C Orion]] aircraft crashes into a hill in [[Pohang]], [[Gyeongsang]], South Korea. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/05/29/south-korean-p3-c-orion-navy-plane-crash-kills-all-four-crew-members-investigation-under-w (Euronews)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Humanitarian impact of the Sudanese civil war]]
***The health ministry of [[Khartoum State]] in [[Sudan]] reports a [[cholera]] outbreak in the state, with 2,119 cases and 242 deaths in the past week and this week, including 70 in the last two days. [https://newscentral.africa/cholera-outbreak-hits-sudan-capital-70-killed-in-two-days/ (News Central TV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Palestine relations]]
**[[Israel]] announces 22 new [[Israeli settlement|settlement]]s in the occupied Palestinian [[West Bank]], the biggest expansion in decades. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1j5954edlno (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Slovakia]]
**[[Slovakia]]’s [[National Bank of Slovakia|central bank]] chief, [[Peter Kažimír]], a member of the [[European Central Bank]] committee, is convicted of [[bribery]] and fined 200,000 [[euros]]. The verdict was issued by Judge Milan Cisarik at the Special Criminal Court in [[Pezinok]]. [https://apnews.com/article/slovakia-corruption-central-bank-governor-convicted-fico-f45809aa68c11d530935dc696755bd29 (AP)]
*''[[Lliuya v RWE AG]]''
**A court in [[Germany]] rejects a lawsuit filed by a [[Peru]]vian farmer against German energy firm [[RWE]]. Saúl Luciano Lliuya alleged that the firm's global emissions contributed to the melting of [[glacier]]s in Peru, threatening his hometown of [[Huaraz]] with [[flooding]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5y5lwveqzno (BBC News)] 
*[[Pamplona massacre]]
**[[Arnolfo Teves Jr.]], the main suspect in the [[Pamplona massacre|assassination]] of [[Negros Oriental]] governor [[Roel Degamo]] in 2023, is [[deport]]ed back to the [[Philippines]] from [[Timor-Leste]] following his arrest yesterday. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/nation/2025/5/29/teves-back-from-timor-leste-2-years-after-degamo-slay-2001 (ABS-CBN News)]
*A court in [[Argentina]] nullifies the ongoing trial of [[Diego Maradona]]'s former medical personnel accused of [[malpractice]] following the removal of one of the trial's judges for alleged lack of [[impartiality]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/05/29/americas/diego-maradona-homicide-trial-declared-invalid-latam-intl (CNN)]
*[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] [[commutation (law)|commutes]] the [[federal prison]] sentence of [[Larry Hoover]], the founder of the [[Chicago]] [[street gang]] [[Gangster Disciples]], who was sentenced to six [[life sentence]]s on [[conspiracy]], [[extortion]], [[drug]] and other criminal charges in the 1990s. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crk27003pv7o (BBC News)]
*[[Ministry of National Security (Argentina)|Argentine security minister]] [[Patricia Bullrich]] announces the arrest of 12 alleged members of [[Tren de Aragua]], which Argentina recently designated as a [[terrorist organization]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-arrests-12-suspects-linked-tren-de-aragua-gang-2025-05-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Nepalese pro-monarchy protests]]
**Tens of thousands of people [[political demonstration|demonstrate]] in [[Kathmandu]], [[Nepal]], asking for the restoration of the country's [[monarchy]] and for [[Hinduism]] to be declared the [[state religion]]. Nepal abolished its monarchy in 2008. [https://apnews.com/article/nepal-protest-restoration-monarchy-king-b6646466a04558c3cfa61b669acc726e (AP)]
*[[2025 Portuguese legislative election]]
**[[Portugal]]'s [[far-right]] [[Chega (political party)|Chega]] party becomes the lead [[parliamentary opposition]] with the second-most seats in [[Parliament of Portugal|parliament]].  [https://apnews.com/article/portugal-politics-chega-far-right-elections-1681e21359a16ea4cd4c38efeeeada0e (AP)]
*[[2025 South Korean presidential election]]
**[[Early voting]] begins in [[South Korea]], from 6:00 am to 6:00 pm [[Time in South Korea|KST]] on today and tomorrow, with a record early voting turnout rate being observed. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-koreans-begin-early-voting-in-presidential-poll (''The Straits Times'')]
